text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Calm down, King. It's alright.
If you just do it carefully—EEK?!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
K-King-san, are you alright~?
I thought I heard a loud voice over here...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second!
We're right at the important part...!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Eeek!
The water! Why is it suddenly overflowing!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank goodness.
We managed to stop it before it boiled over.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Sounds great! Making bento lunches ♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Doing it all on your own for nutritional management
is super amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A bento, huh~.
I can only make simple things.
Like octopus sausages.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Whenever I make it, I always add candied carrots. They're so sweet, I love them!♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Hey, you two,
why don't you make that for King?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Feel free to use the ingredients however you like.
...If it turns out well, I might just add it to 'King's First-Class Bento'♪"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"T-The legs are all different thicknesses, but...
you take one-third of the sausage and cut it in half, then half, then half again! Like that!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, isn't that nice!
King's great taste really shines here♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! Why did you cut that leg off?!
Now it only has 7 legs...!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, it's done. It may be simple,
but it's a colorful and nutritious dish.”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, finished already? ...Though, it'd look tastier with a bit more glaze on it♪
...Wait, huh? It's burnt!?!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
F-Finally got a clean crack...
Jeez, why do eggs have to be so fragile?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Given how many eggs we have left, a do-over won't be easy.
Looks like we only get one shot at this tamagoyaki.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A-All or nothing...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, tamagoyaki, huh...
I've never been able to make it look neat."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Hmph! Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Making a rolled omelet in one perfect go is child's play for King!
...Just watch me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(One-third of the egg mixture? About this much?
...No, eyeballing it is dangerous.
Remember the octopus leg incident, King...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(Is this too simple, I wonder?
...No, no. Stick to the recipe first.
I won't let the burnt bits of the glacé go to waste.)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-It's okay, don't rush, King.
Just take it easy.
Nice and easy... nice and easy...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
......I-I did it...
I did it, right...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Amazing! That's amazing, King!
Such a gorgeously cooked tamagoyaki~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's evenly baked, and thick enough too.
Hehe, it looks absolutely delicious!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Ohoho! Ooohohoho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, naturally. Who do you take me for?
I am a top-tier Umamusume who can even cook a rolled omelet to absolute perfection——

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's King Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Look at the time.
If I don't pack this into the bento box soon, he'll leave!"

Swamped with chores and utterly exhausted by evening.
Staring blankly at what had been casually placed on my desk.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What's with that look?
If you don't want it, I'll just take it home, you know?

Told that, I frantically took it.
Opening it up as prompted, inside was—

Octopus-shaped sausages, glazed carrots, tamagoyaki...
The bento box was still faintly warm, and before I knew it, I had picked up the chopsticks.

The tamagoyaki brought to my mouth was subtly sweet and warm.
It gently permeated throughout my tired body.
choice_data_list: Delicious... You're really good at making rolled omelets.
Delicious... You're really good at making rolled omelets.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! I am King, after all!
Making tamagoyaki is a piece of cake for me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So you see, there's really no need
to savor every bite so intensely, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If you continue to dedicate yourself to the King, I'll make it for you again ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"T-The slight char is just the King-style twist! An accent!
It's not like I messed up or anything—"

It's sweet and crumbly soft when you bite into it.
With just a hint of toasty char, it brings a smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho! Isn't that right?
Now! Eat to your heart's content!
And then you can serve King all the more!
